past_events.title: California PUC approves Waymo robotaxi expansion across 18 counties incl. full Bay Area/LA
past_events.why: Regulatory green light widens Waymo's addressable commercial footprint

past_events.title: Berkshire Hathaway 13F shows Alphabet stake up 83% to $37.8B, its 3rd-largest holding
past_events.why: High-profile validation from Buffett/Berkshire during AI-spend skepticism

past_events.title: Waymo launches public robotaxi service in Denver, San Diego and Tampa (14 cities total)
past_events.why: Accelerating commercial scale-up of a key non-search growth optionality

past_events.title: Judge Brinkema rejects DOJ's AdX divestiture bid in ad tech antitrust case
past_events.why: Removed tail-risk of an ad-tech breakup; Google keeps both sides of the market

GOOGL.pe_narrative: GOOGL's forward P/E troughed near 17x in mid-2025 on fears it was the AI 'loser' vs ChatGPT-driven search disruption, then re-rated to the high-20s by early 2026 as Gemini 3, external TPU deals (Meta, Anthropic) and 63-82% Cloud growth flipped the story to 'AI winner.' Since Q2'26's $195-205B capex guide and first negative FCF quarter, capex fear has pulled multiples back toward the high-teens.

guidance_revisions.change: FY25 capex guidance raised to $91-93B from ~$85B prior
Initial FY26 capex guidance set at $175-185B, more than double FY25 spend
FY26 capex raised to $180-190B from $175-185B, reflecting Intersect Power inclusion
FY26 capex raised again to $195-205B from $180-190B; contractual commitments now exceed $800B

preview.expects: Consensus (est.): revenue ~$130.8B, core EPS ~$3.00-3.10, per sell-side models; bar is high given back-to-back beat-and-raise prints that still sold off on capex/FCF fears (est.)
watch: Whether FY26 capex guide is raised again past $195-205B, and any 2027 capex framework
Free cash flow trajectory after Q2's first-ever negative FCF (-$5.9B) quarter
Google Cloud backlog growth pace (was $514B) and cloud operating margin trend
Ad-tech remedy compliance costs following Sept 2 Brinkema ruling on auction practices
preview.read: Market now punishes headline beats on capex optics; asymmetry skews to 'good print, bad reaction' unless FCF shows a credible inflection.

past_events.title: FY2025 results: profit +17% YoY to RMB259.6bn; AI-agent strategy underwhelms despite 13% sales growth
past_events.why: Full-year AI monetization proof point; market wanted a concrete agent roadmap, not just capex intent

past_events.title: Tencent details plan to launch Hunyuan 3.0 in April and build a WeChat AI agent
past_events.why: First concrete timeline for closing the perceived AI-agent gap versus ByteDance's Doubao

past_events.title: Tencent folds AI Lab into Hunyuan team in major AI reorg
past_events.why: Signaled internal consolidation and urgency behind the AI push beyond just capital spending

past_events.title: Q1 2026 results (revenue +9% YoY) plus AGM mandate to buy back up to ~10% of shares
past_events.why: Tested capital-return commitment just as capex began ramping (+16% YoY)

past_events.title: Nintendo Switch China eShop shut down as the Tencent-Nintendo distribution deal ends
past_events.why: Ends a console-distribution partnership in China, a minor but symbolic gaming-portfolio exit

past_events.title: Reports say Tencent is set to launch a WeChat AI agent, seeking compliance clearance for a June rollout
past_events.why: First real product proof Tencent could monetize WeChat's 1.3bn MAU base via AI agents

past_events.title: US DoD adds Tencent to the Section 1260H list of Chinese military companies
past_events.why: Bars Tencent from US federal contracting/procurement; headline geopolitical policy risk

past_events.title: Tencent ramps monthly buybacks to ~HK$10bn, its largest this year, amid a ~$309bn market-value rout
past_events.why: Signals management's view on valuation support as AI-capex fears drove a sustained de-rating

past_events.title: Launches Hunyuan Hy3 with a free AI-agent feature bundled into Yuanbao, slashes API pricing
past_events.why: Aimed to widen Yuanbao's user base and defend against Doubao by removing the paywall on agents

past_events.title: Erste Group cuts FY26 EPS estimates for Tencent on capex-driven margin concerns
past_events.why: Early sell-side signal that AI spend was starting to bite consensus earnings forecasts

past_events.title: Q2 2026 results: revenue +11% YoY beats, but capex +190% YoY flips FCF negative (-RMB13.8bn)
past_events.why: First quarter FCF turned negative since 2019 - direct test of the 'AI spend vs return' thesis

past_events.title: Benchmark and Mizuho cut price targets on Tencent citing AI investment costs and return concerns
past_events.why: Sell-side split emerging between growth bulls and valuation-discipline bears post-Q2 capex shock

0700.pe_narrative: Tencent re-rated up toward ~18x forward P/E in 2025 on buybacks and early AI-monetization optimism, then compressed to ~12x (TTM 16x vs 10-yr median 25x) by mid-2026 as Q2 capex jumped 190% YoY and FCF turned negative for the first time since 2019, reviving fears AI spend won't earn adequate returns while Doubao pulls engagement (Morningstar, Bloomberg).

guidance_revisions.change: Guided AI product investment (Hunyuan/Yuanbao) to more than double in FY26 to over RMB36B from RMB18B in FY25; no hard FY26 capex figure given
Reaffirmed a 'substantial increase' in FY26 capex vs FY25's RMB79.2B, flagging a particularly large step-up in H2'26 as China-made ASICs become available
Capex guided to stay elevated through H2'26; management said it would shift more cash from buybacks to capex if AI-compute returns remain attractive

preview.expects: Consensus ~RMB211B revenue (est.), EPS ~1.09 (est.); the bar is on capex trajectory and FCF, not just top-line growth
watch: Capex growth: further QoQ acceleration vs stabilization post H2 ASIC ramp
FCF trend: stays negative or inflects back positive/ex-prepayment basis
WeChat AI agent rollout: usage/monetization KPIs since June 2026 reports
Buyback pace: sustained vs redirected toward capex per Q2 comments
preview.read: Market has priced heavy AI-capex pain; a capex/FCF stabilization signal, not just a revenue beat, is what could spark relief.
